summary: Digital Brands Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that 9.6 million cash warrants expired on June 17, 2026, and that 7.1 million pre-funded warrants had been cancelled earlier that week, eliminating a total dilution overhang of 16.7 million shares. No financial terms, premium, or consideration are involved; no board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a routine disclosure of warrant expiration and cancellation, not a special-situation event such as a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. Watch for no further risk-arb angle as this is a non-transactional capital-structure update.
